answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 41630 Country: India Title: Wearing of gold in the leg e.g. pazeb (anklet) for a women is haram or halal and what does hadith say about it. Question: Wearing of gold in the leg e.g. pazeb (anklet) for a women is haram or halal and what does hadith say about it. Answer ID: 41630 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1528/1149/D=1433) Pazeb (anklet) is an ornament worn by women in legs. It is lawful to wear it. However, it should not have ghungru (small bells) to avoid sound while walking. It is forbidden for men and boys to wear it: قال فى الدر ويكره للولى الباس الخلخال ... للصبى قال الشامى اى الذكر لانه من زينۃ النساء . (شامى ج 5 ص 298) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
